items.subject: Fwd: P week
items.summary: Jande forwarded Hunter McGary's missionary week update from Ensenada.
items.body:
,,,,, Forwarded message ,,,,-
From: Hunter McGary <hunter.mcgary@missionary.org>
Date: Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 8:51 AM
Subject: P week
To: Jande <jande.mcgary5@gmail.com>

What is up my wonderful friends and family, I hope you all had an amazing
week! This week for me was kinda like the others but had some highlight. So
lets get to it!

Bappy!
This is going to be really fast, but pretty much the hermanas in our
district had a bappy coming up and I had the opportunity to baptize him. It
was super cool always but like didnt feel the same bc I didnt do the work
to get his fetcha.

Halloween/ Día de los Muertos
I'll be honest, kinda lame here at Ensenada. I was expecting something like
super big and exiting but it was kinda just like a normal day. But it was
raining so that could have like canceled something but who knows.

P week
Im writing this at the end so then hopefully you read the entire thing. The
reason why its going to be a p week is bc, its officially my comps last
week in the mission. And I love him but hes the type of guy to do this. He
even told me, he goes "hey bro not even gonna lie, this week is probably
gonna be a p week. It my last week and i wanna have fun!" Like buddy, your
going home in literally 9 days your telling me you cant work for 9 days. So
ig we will see what happens, so stay tuned for next weeks email.

Transfer
So ya really quick, Transfer are on the 11th and there is like a 50/50
chance I stay in el Roble. Bc since my comp is going home, idk if they want
to white wash the area, and with that there is also a chance that I train!
So ya next weeks email is going to have a lot of excitement .

Ayta hope you all have an amazing week, feel free to email or message me, I
love it when I get emails or messages hearing about your weeks. I'll talk
to you all next week, stay safe!

Love
Elder McGary
